goal: Read docs/agent-work/github-project-ops.md and prepare or perform the safe GitHub Project operations pass for Kolibri. GitHub Project is the external operating screen; Control Plane remains the source of truth for task state, lease, result and artifacts. If gh/project OAuth scope is unavailable, do not treat that as success: produce an issue/PR/report artifact with Project sync: pending and the exact blocker. Do not add new Project fields, do not publish secrets or private investor contact details, and do not mark items Done without artifact/result/PR and closed acceptance. If authenticated tooling is available, audit tasks/issues/PRs for required fields, status mapping, blockers, CI/review state and next report.
role_goal: keep GitHub Project, issues, PRs, CI and Control Plane artifact references aligned without hiding blockers

must_cover: Control Plane state to Project status mapping
role_catalog.fallback: If Project API scope is missing, write Project sync: pending with exact reason.

acceptance: Result lists audited issue/PR/Project or Control Plane items, or clearly states why authenticated sync was blocked
Each relevant item has or is mapped to status, priority, direction, agent, next report and artifacts
Control Plane task items reference task_id and do not conflict with actual task state/result references
CI/review failures are classified as in progress or blocked with exact reason, never silently ignored
Investor/docs items avoid unsupported public claims and private contact disclosure
If gh Project scope is missing, result includes Project sync: pending, blocker owner and next action
